description:
**Technical Lead – Mobile Application Development** 




**Experience:** 
**8\+ Years** 




**Location: Noida / Mumbai (Onsite)** 




**Fulltime Permanent role** 




  





  





**Job Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Technical Lead – Mobile Application Development to lead our mobile engineering team and take ownership of the technical implementation and delivery of high\-quality mobile applications.
 



 The Technical Lead will be responsible for providing technical direction, making architectural and implementation decisions, mentoring team members, and ensuring the successful delivery of mobile applications. The ideal candidate
 



 should have strong hands\-on experience in native Android/iOS development, Flutter, backend API integration,socket\-based communication, and mobile application architecture, along with strong problem\-solving and teamleadership skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Technical Leadership
 



 ● Lead the technical design, development, implementation, testing, and deployment of mobile applications.
 



 ● Define and maintain mobile application architecture, coding standards, development practices, and technical
 



 guidelines.
 



 ● Make appropriate technical decisions and ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and
 



 performant.
 



 ● Review technical requirements and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
 



 ● Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering best practices.
 



 ● Identify and resolve complex technical challenges and production issues.
 



 ● Work closely with backend, QA, product, UI/UX, and other engineering teams to ensure smooth end\-to\-end delivery.
 



**Mobile Application Development** 




 ● Be actively involved in hands\-on coding and development, contributing directly to the implementation of
 



 key features, modules, and complex technical components.
 



 ● Provide hands\-on technical guidance for Android and iOS native application development.
 



 ● Lead development using Native/Flutter and ensure effective use of cross\-platform development practices.
 



 ● Design and implement integrations with RESTful APIs, backend services, WebSockets/sockets, and
 



 real\-time communication systems.
 



 ● Ensure applications are optimized for performance, stability, scalability, security, and reliability.
 



 ● Troubleshoot complex application issues including crashes, performance bottlenecks, network issues, and
 



 integration problems.
 



 ● Stay current with emerging mobile technologies, frameworks, tools, and industry best practices.
 



**Team Management \& Mentoring** 




 ● Lead, mentor, and guide mobile developers in their day\-to\-day technical work.
 



 ● Allocate technical tasks and ensure effective utilization of team members.
 



 ● Provide technical guidance and support to developers when dealing with complex implementation challenges.
 



 ● Conduct code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
 



 ● Help team members improve their technical skills and development practices.
 



 ● Monitor progress, identify technical risks, and proactively address delivery challenges.
 



 ● Work with project/product leadership to ensure commitments are delivered within agreed timelines and quality standards.
 



**Delivery \& Collaboration** 




 ● Own the technical delivery of mobile application projects from development through release.
 



 ● Break down requirements into technical tasks and provide effort and implementation estimates.
 



 ● Identify dependencies, risks, and technical challenges early in the development lifecycle.
 



 ● Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, UI/UX Designers, QA Engineers, Backend Engineers, and DevOps teams.
 



 ● Ensure proper documentation of architecture, technical decisions, APIs, and development processes.
 



 ● Participate in release planning, production deployments, and post\-release issue resolution.
 



**Required Skills \& Experience** 




 ● 8\+ years of experience in mobile application development, with relevant experience in a technical leadership role.
 



 ● Strong hands\-on experience in Flutter and SWIFT/Kotlin(Jetpack Compose).
 



 ● Strong experience in native Android and/or iOS application development.
 



 ● Solid understanding of mobile application architecture and design patterns.
 



 ● Strong experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs and backend services.
 



 ● Hands\-on experience with WebSockets, sockets, or other real\-time communication technologies.
 



 ● Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, networking, data handling, and mobile performance
 



 optimization.
 



 ● Experience working with application state management and scalable Flutter application architecture.
 



 ● Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 ● Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
 



 ● Good understanding of mobile application security, performance, and release processes.
 



 ● Experience leading, mentoring, and managing a team of mobile developers.
 



 ● Strong communication and collaboration skills.
 



  





**Preferred Experience** 




 ● Experience working on trading, financial services, stock market, brokerage, or investment
 



 applications will be preferred.
 



 ● Familiarity with real\-time market data, live price feeds, order placement, portfolio/position
 



 management, and trading workflows is an advantage.
 



 ● Experience developing applications that require low\-latency communication, real\-time updates,
 



 WebSockets/sockets, and high availability will be highly valued.
 



 ● Understanding of the technical challenges associated with financial/trading applications, including reliability,
 



 performance, security, and data consistency, will be an added advantage.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Java Full Stack Technical Lead, you will be expected to work as a self\-driven individual contributor with strong ownership of end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of product features across both backend and frontend layers. You should be hands\-on in Java\-based backend services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud\-native deployments, and modern frontend development using frameworks such as React or Angular. Along with independent technical contribution, the role requires mentoring junior engineers in the team, guiding implementation decisions, reviewing code, ensuring secure and high\-quality delivery, supporting customer escalations, and driving innovation through PoCs and continuous improvements.
   

  

**Job Requirement And Responsibilities**
* The Java Full Stack Technical Lead will be responsible for independently leading product feature development across backend and frontend layers, including design, implementation, validation, and delivery of scalable software applications and systems.
* The candidate should be hands\-on and technically strong enough to contribute as an individual contributor while also providing technical leadership, design direction, code reviews, and guidance to the team.
* Mandatory experience is required in both backend engineering using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, databases, and cloud\-native patterns, as well as frontend engineering using React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, UI integration, and responsive web application development.
* You need to follow development processes and security processes, and will ensure the technical quality of the solution with UTs coverage and handle/identify security vulnerabilities.
* You will work on Customers escalated issues.
* You will get exposure to working on cutting\-edge technologies and innovation events.
* Drive innovation by proposing, prototyping, and evaluating new technical solutions (PoCs), and contribute to continuous improvements in performance, scalability, and developer productivity.
* Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and processes.
* Technologies should not be a constraint for the right person; however, strong hands\-on exposure to Java full stack development is mandatory. The role involves Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, Kubernetes, and ownership of deployments and chart definitions for our applications.


**Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 10\+ years of application development experience, including strong hands\-on Java full stack development across backend and frontend technologies.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing and implementing REST API based backend applications using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot frameworks.
* Strong exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular is mandatory, with the ability to collaborate on UI architecture, review frontend implementation, and ensure seamless integration with backend services.
* Core knowledge in Data Structures, OOPS, Solid design principles, and common Design Patterns is must.
* Working exposure to any cloud stack (GCP, AWS) is must.
* Leveraging AI in routine work or personal POCs will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to Cloud and Kubernetes\-based applications will be an important factor.
* The ideal candidate should be technology\-agnostic, adaptable, and comfortable learning and working across different languages, frameworks, and platforms as required.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud\-friendly programming language such as Python or Node.js. will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Unit Testing and any automation (BDD) framework will be nice to have.
* Good exposure to any relational database MSSQL or MySql.
* Exposure in Micro Services architecture and Docker based application will be an added advantage.


**What do we offer?**
 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Lead Mobile SDET
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti\-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
   

  

 At OneSpan we are looking for a
 **Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)** 
 — a strong software engineer who specializes in test — to architect and own our QA automation frameworks and strategy across the entire Mobile Security Suite (MSS) SDK portfolio. Our Mobile Security Suite (MSS) spans multiple SDKs across iOS, Android, and server\-side platforms (.NET and Java).
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: part hands\-on automation engineer, part technical lead. You will work alongside our Android automation developer, manual QA engineer, and feature developers, contribute directly to test automation across all MSS SDKs, and design the frameworks, tooling, strategy, and roadmap that take our QA practice to the next level.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Test Strategy: Assess current automation coverage across all MSS SDKs (iOS, Android, server\-side), identify gaps, and define the testing strategy, tooling, and project setup needed to close them.
* Contribute Hands\-On: Design, write, and maintain automated tests across iOS, Android, and server\-side SDKs — using AI coding tools and partnering with feature developers on platforms where you need extra language or domain support.
* Own the Pipelines: Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines (YAML), Bash scripts, and Gradle builds across our multiple SDK pipelines to run automated suites, stand up local/test servers, and integrate with real\-device testing cloud solutions.
* Drive Planning \& Reporting: Prepare quality and coverage reports, and bring recommendations and next steps to quarterly planning with engineering leadership.
* Mentor the Team: Guide the automation developers, feature developers, and QA engineers who contribute to automation; help formalize processes, code review standards, and best practices.
* Keep Growing: Stay current with mobile and server\-side testing tools and frameworks; proactively identify and fill missing skills or tooling gaps on the team.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Automation Leadership: 6\+ years in software test automation, including experience defining test strategy and leading or mentoring other engineers.
* Framework Architecture: Proven track record designing, building, and maintaining test automation frameworks and harnesses from the ground up — abstraction layers, reusable components, test data and fixtures — not just writing tests against an existing suite.
* Mobile Automation Expertise: Deep hands\-on mobile test automation in at least one mobile stack — iOS (Swift, XCTest/XCUITest) or Android (Kotlin, Compose Test/Espresso/UI Automator) — with the ability to extend to the other and to server\-side, using AI coding tools and feature\-developer support to bridge gaps.
* Test Infrastructure: Builds and owns the test infrastructure that runs the suites, including integration with the third\-party real\-device cloud services we use for tests that need real hardware.
* CI/CD \& Scripting: GitLab CI and YAML pipeline authoring, Bash scripting, Gradle.
* Version Control: Git and standard branching / pull request workflows.
* Comfortable working across a multi\-language, multi\-platform codebase and picking up a new language or framework when a project requires it.


**Nice to Have**
* Server\-Side: Java, Spring or Spring Boot, JUnit 4 and JUnit 5\.
* .NET / C\# experience, to extend automation coverage to .NET\-based server components.
* Experience testing security\-sensitive SDKs (e.g., anti\-tampering, threat detection, RASP) or working in a regulated / security\-conscious product environment.
* Prior experience leading or building a QA automation function from an early stage.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong leadership and mentoring instincts, with the ability to influence without formal authority.
* Clear communicator, comfortable presenting test strategy, status, and risks to management.
* Analytical and gap\-driven — able to look at a large, multi\-platform codebase and identify where quality risk actually lives.
* Eager to learn and self\-directed in closing skill or tooling gaps.

title: Head of Voice AI Development
description:
You'll own voice AI at JoyzAI. All of it. The real\-time pipeline (audio in, speech understood, LLM reasoning, tools called, speech out), the telephony that gets the call connected, the platform a client uses to configure and run their agent, and the webhooks and CRM plumbing that turn a call into a lead. It's a working product with real clients on it today. Your job is to take it from working to something we'd bet the company on, and to build the team that keeps it that way.
 



 This is a head\-of role at a company of under 15 people, which makes it a player\-coach job. You set the technical direction for voice: what we build on, what we buy, what we rip out. And you write a lot of the code yourself. When a call stutters, drops, or talks over the customer, you're the one who finds out why, fixes it at the root, and changes the system so it can't happen again. When a client wants an agent that does something we've never done, you decide whether the platform can, and then you make it so.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





**Own the voice stack** 



* Set the architecture and roadmap for the real\-time calling pipeline: telephony ↔ audio streaming ↔ speech/real\-time models ↔ tool calls ↔ speech out, with latency you can't feel.
* Own the hard voice problems, with opinions earned in production: turn\-taking and barge\-in, silence and voicemail detection, noise and echo, language switching mid\-call (English ↔ Hinglish ↔ regional), and graceful recovery when a model or carrier hiccups.
* Make the build\-vs\-buy calls across STT/TTS, real\-time LLMs, VAD, and telephony carriers. Run the evaluations, own the vendor relationships, decide what we build on next, and know when it's time to switch.
* Design non\-blocking tool calling inside live calls (lookups, bookings, CRM writes) so the agent never goes silent or loses the thread.
* Define what "good" means for a voice agent: the quality bar, the evaluation framework, the test harness. We should know a change made agents better before a client tells us.



  





**Build the platform around the calls** 



* Own the Node.js/Express services and APIs that have to hold up as call volume grows: call orchestration, queueing, webhooks, retries, recording and transcript storage.
* Own the product around the calls: agent configuration (tasks, behaviour, guardrails, AI config), call logs and transcripts, analytics, and bulk\-calling campaign controls.
* Wire calls into the rest of the platform: CRM contacts and tickets, WhatsApp follow\-ups after a call, calendar and booking integrations, Google Sheets and Meta lead\-form ingestion.
* Keep the Angular frontends our team and clients use (the agent configurator, the inbox, the call review screens) clean and usable, whether you're writing them or reviewing them.



  





**Reliability, cost \& scale** 



* Instrument everything: time\-to\-first\-word, per\-call latency breakdowns, drop rates, tool\-call failures, model cost per minute. Own the dashboards that tell us something's wrong before a client does.
* Treat cost per minute as a number you're accountable for. Bring it down without hurting quality: model choice, streaming strategy, caching, carrier routing.
* Own production. Debug incidents on real client calls, reproduce them, fix them at the root, and build the incident and on\-call practice so the next one gets caught faster.



  





**Lead the team** 



* Build and lead the voice engineering team. Hire, set the bar, review the code, and make the engineers around you better.
* Own the engineering standard for voice: architecture decisions, code quality, documentation, what ships and what doesn't.
* Pair with the prompt engineer and customer success on what the platform needs for agents to behave well: new tool types, better fallbacks, a proper test harness for prompts.
* Be the technical authority in front of clients on the hard deployments, the ones where the answer isn't in the docs yet.
* Turn what you learn from client deployments into reusable platform capability, so the next voice agent takes hours to stand up, not days.



  





 Roughly 60% of your time is hands\-on: architecting, coding, debugging live calls, shipping. The other 40% is leading: the team, the roadmap, model and vendor decisions, and the client conversations where the platform's direction gets decided. That ratio shifts toward leading as the team grows, but you never stop being able to open the code and fix it yourself.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





 Three things are non\-negotiable. Please apply only if you meet all three. They're the first thing we screen for.
 



  




* **You have successfully deployed voice AI agents to production, and owned them there.** 
 Not a demo, not a hackathon, not a pilot that quietly ended. A system where real customers spoke to an AI over a phone line or live audio stream, at real volume, for months, and it stayed in production because it worked. You owned the pipeline end to end: streaming audio, speech and real\-time models, latency, interruptions, the failures at 2am, the cost. In our first conversation we'll ask what you shipped, how many calls it handled, what broke, and what you did about it. Come with specifics. Experience at a Voice AI company is a strong signal.



  




* **You can build the whole thing yourself.** 
 Backend services, APIs, real\-time transport, databases, and a frontend a client can use without a walkthrough. You've done this as an individual contributor and you can still do it. A head of voice who can't debug the socket is not who we're hiring.



  




* **You've set the technical direction for a voice product before.** 
 As a founding engineer, tech lead, architect, or head of engineering. The title matters less than the fact that people looked to you for what to build and how, and you were right often enough that the product worked.



  





 Beyond that, we don't care much about degrees or years. We care that you can:
 



  




* Work fluently across the MEAN stack — MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js — with TypeScript throughout.
* Design and debug real\-time systems: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming audio, event\-driven architectures, queues.
* Integrate with telephony/SIP providers and messaging APIs (WhatsApp Business API) and handle their quirks in production.
* Work with LLM APIs, tool/function calling, and speech models, and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes, not just accuracy.
* Design MongoDB data models and APIs for a multi\-tenant SaaS: contacts, conversations, tickets, workflows, role\-based access.
* Hire well, review well, and explain a hard technical call to a founder or a client in plain language.
* Measure and profile before you optimise, write code others can read, and document what you built.



  





 Nice to have: deep experience with real\-time voice frameworks or APIs (OpenAI Realtime, LiveKit, Pipecat, or similar); Indian telephony providers; Hinglish or Indic speech models; GCP/AWS at scale; having scaled a voice product from its first client to serious call volume; having built a voice team from scratch.
 



  





 Full\-time, on\-site in Noida.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




  





 ✨ Utmost freedom and autonomy — voice AI is yours. Make the decisions, set the direction, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨ Complete responsibility. You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨ Top\-of\-the\-market pay – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨ 5\-day working – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨ Work from office in Noida – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨ High\-growth startup – opportunity to see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.
